title: 1Password desktop app data
whyItMatters: 1Password keeps its local database, cache and logs in this folder. It shows the app was used on this PC and may hold account metadata even while the vault is locked.
source: 1Password Support, How to uninstall 1Password: Windows data folder %LOCALAPPDATA%/1Password - https://support.1password.com/uninstall-1password/
notes: The app's settings file is under %APPDATA%/1Password/settings and is not covered here. Logs live under %LOCALAPPDATA%/1Password/logs. Nothing is opened or decrypted.

cleanup.exportFirst: Confirm you can sign in to your 1Password account and have your Secret Key and Emergency Kit, then export any vault you need.
cleanup.signOut: Sign out of 1Password on this PC and remove this device from the authorized devices in your account settings.
steps: Confirm the account sign-in details and Emergency Kit are available.
Sign out of 1Password on this PC.
Uninstall 1Password from Settings > Apps > Installed apps.
Delete the 1Password folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes the local 1Password database and settings from this PC. Data that is only in the account stays in the cloud.
